Official Roland Eotvos Physical Society (ELFT) seal. Its official competition notice identifies the Eotvos physics competition as an ELFT competition. Used as the organizer mark rather than claiming a separate event logo. Asset bytes unchanged.

Official Harvard University shield, used as an organizer-university mark. The official BAUPC archive states that Harvard Physics Department graduate students organize the competition and that Harvard Physics Department supports it. No independent BAUPC logo was found. Source asset is the shield published as Harvard University own site icon; asset bytes unchanged.

Official Chinese Physical Society (CPS) header logo, used as the organizer mark. The official CPhO regulations identify CPS as organizer and explicitly give the English name Chinese Physics Olympiad. General CPS mark avoids implying that a particular year finals logo represents every year. Asset bytes unchanged.
